label: There is a universal modal frame and a time-indexed state that holds initially and fails later…
meaning: There is a universal modal frame and a time-indexed state that holds initially and fails later, yet holds initially in every accessible world. Change alone supplies no contrary possibility at the same time. An analyst’s model/consequence test; no result proves Kantian idealism, real possibility, premise truth or a refutation of God. See docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
